summary: The change scopes the arrow icon hover translation to fine-pointer devices without a reduced-motion preference. Panel, project card, and button hover rules already avoid transform movement, while color and focus feedback remain available.

evidence: At public/styles.css:316-321 the arrow hover transform is inside a media query requiring hover, fine pointer, and prefers-reduced-motion no-preference, so reduced-motion users no longer receive icon-link movement.
At public/styles.css:1107-1125 the panel and project card hover rules only change box-shadow and border-color, so panel and card hover lifts are absent in the candidate.
At public/styles.css:301-304 button hover only changes border-color and background, and the focus-visible outlines at 323-329 remain, preserving color and focus feedback.
Fine-pointer users without a reduced-motion preference still match the new query and retain the 3px arrow translation.
